summary: Not a standing tower: the Bradley County entry is the top of a former Ooltewah (Hamilton County) tower now displayed at the Ocoee Regional Nature Center.

facts.status_note: tnlandforms lists it as sitting; the top section is an exhibit at the Ocoee Regional Nature Center, not a lookout on its own site.

corrections.why: Both tnlandforms waypoint pages describe this entry as an exhibit of the top of the former Ooltewah tower, listed as sitting, not a standing tower on its own site.

notes_for_editor: Both facts come from one hobbyist site (tnlandforms), which says the Ocoee exhibit is a top section of the Ooltewah tower. Build date, removal date and move date were not found. The Ocoee Regional Nature Center's own pages were not checked, so the display's current status is unconfirmed. Kind may be better recorded as exhibit than tower.
